Seat 1's post is #7623 (os-tesla); this seat does not touch seat 1's cards or ledgers. Body **r3f**, written 2026-10-07T13:48Z by `session_0181E4ZeZmWyknawnauxD2CE` (os-steve) after the CI assessment's five cards were filed on the maintainer's instruction. r3a–r3e and the r2 series are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated.

## Current PM

🟢 **os-steve** — `session_0181E4ZeZmWyknawnauxD2CE`, seated 2026-10-06T13:59Z on the maintainer's `/pm-dispatch skills` in this session; round-open marker 6017926700 (R1, fully closed out). Default wake-up: patrol Routine `trig_01AGpv4wMw88KexCH41wPrGH` (hourly at :57, self-bound). Batch 3; `mode:subagent` for S/M. Served tier = `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`get_session` `last_served_model`, re-read before each `## Contract review`; last read 2026-10-06T21:15Z). Rate-limit status: `seven_day` / `allowed_warning`. **Posture: standby, dispatch held** — the maintainer's instruction 「创建卡片,暂时不派发。」 holds the five cards filed under it; whether it also covers the one queue card (#21892) is an open question put to the maintainer in chat; no claim until it is answered. R2 opens with the four mutex readings when it is.

## Inherited + running ledger

- **Queue (`pm:queue` ∩ `domain:skills`): 1** — #21892 (p1; the maintainer released seat 1's claim through triage, comment 6030225651 at 2026-10-07T03:22Z: 「21892 释放认领」; branch `claude/issue-21892-no-run-is-unconfirmed` at `4c5f2c15fc`, 7 commits, kept for the next claimant, who merges `main` into it, ⛔ no rebase). #21915 (p3) was closed `not_planned` by triage at 2026-10-07T06:56Z under `triage-duties.md:34` and `:64` (a `tooling` card with no `Unblocks:` product card while the lane's queue holds an undispatched P1); its serial hold is spent; the issue-`type` write-path gap it described is carried by #22060 W1. objectui: 0. **In flight (devs): 0.**
- **Landed this shift (closed out):** PR #21999 (#21929, Tier S) squash `1bc6ca1d` MERGED 2026-10-06T15:42Z; PR #22000 (#21992, Tier S) squash `803764a3` MERGED 2026-10-06T15:58Z; PR #22002 (#21959, Tier H by size) squash `5bd8cb10` MERGED 2026-10-07T05:02Z after `os-zhuang` approved, flipped ready, armed auto-merge and enqueued it; reviews of record PASS 6019414425 (`95c510eb`) and successor PASS 6025638745 (`fab444b4`); close-out done (card closed by `Fixes`, `pm:dispatched` and the PR's `needs-user-decision` stripped, reconciliation clean). **Landing window: 0.**
- **Decision box: 3 of this seat's cards** in the maintainer's `needs-user-decision` inbox — #22051 (the >5000-line SIZE limb on a ruled pure deletion and a clock for the Tier H wait; recommends D, no change; triage p3), #22059 (a CI gate over the published `skills/**` teaching text; recommends B with a probe precondition; triage p3), #22083 (the hourly CI+Lint full-run cadence; recommends A, keep — the repository is public so the minutes are unbilled, `main` had commits in 152 of the last 168 hours, and the per-run cost is the structural lever). Each carries 维护者速读 and the four-facet block.
- **Held under the maintainer's instruction (`pm:on-hold`, `Restart-when:` the maintainer or the director seat lifts the hold):** #22052 (relay op `pr_update_branch`; triage p1), #22053 (reclaim clock and write path for a silent claim; triage p2), #22060 (program anchor W1–W7; triage p3 `tracking`).

- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`: FROZEN (ruling 208 R6), untouched; its unfreeze-and-split is W3 on #22060; #22076 may need one self-test flag in it and must quote the maintainer's unfreeze for exactly that.

## Notes

- Job description: `references/lanes/skills.md`. Write paths (verified this shift): `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (`--repo=owner/name`; `--ack-through=ID` for body refreshes), `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` (`--add`/`--remove`, labels on PRs too), `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs` (`--title-file` / `--body-file` / `--label`; title cap 256 bytes), `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file` (`issue_patch`, `comment_edit`, `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`, `pr_request_reviewers`); route `dispatch`; ⛔ no MCP write. Bare REST per `rest-channel.md:49`: `PUT .../pulls/{n}/update-branch` (used once; the merge commit it made is authored by the seat's personal account — #22052). CI re-runs: MCP `actions_run_trigger rerun_failed_jobs` answers 201 for the seat (REST 403).
- Landing: Tier S = at-tier `## Contract review` PASS in seat, then `check-expected-skips --pr N` exit 0 + `check-governed-merges --pr N` exit 3 reading Tier S, then the relay flip; the ready flip re-triggers the label-sensitive `Governed Surface Queue Guard` (observed 9 minutes). A Tier H PR may be flipped ready and armed by the approving human; the seat's close-out is unchanged.
- Predecessor-dependent PR (landing-operations §C), as practised on #22002: the body carries the expected-red list and the release condition; after the predecessor merges, one `update-branch`, then a successor `## Contract review` naming the new head, then the Tier terminal continues; when every check is green the parked section becomes a synced note.
- Filing: `filing-gate.md:29` — three cards per fire; ten cards this shift went out over four fires with accelerators carrying the overflow. `triage-duties.md:34` / `:64` — a `tooling` card's first line carries `Unblocks: #N` or names the guarded surface, or a maintainer instruction quoted verbatim, else triage closes it while the lane's queue holds an undispatched P0/P1 (#21915).
- Liveness baseline measured this shift (`mode:subagent`, S/M governed-text cards): dispatch → draft PR 32 / 35 / 49 minutes; the 45-minute probe threshold held without a probe. Queue latency observed: enqueue → MERGED 27, 24 and 34 minutes.
- Platform readings this shift: (1) a relay `issue_patch` carrying `body` on a PR number stores the bytes identical — no footer appended; (2) `Validate Package Dependencies` is path-filtered and inherits `main`'s OSV red (#22013 fixed; the PR-side judgment is #22082); (3) a type-check lane could be cancelled at checkout by a ten-minute wall (#22020, fixed by #22033; root cause #22034); (4) `pm:seat` `list_issues` with `body` overflows, and MCP multi-label `list_issues` is a union — REST `labels=a,b` for AND; (5) a shell variable holding backticked text expands them — claim text goes through files; (6) `gh api --paginate` breaks through the proxy — loop `&page=N` and stop on the RAW page length; (7) `gh api --jq .body` appends one newline — strip it before a whole-body `issue_patch`; (8) a subagent's transcript does not survive a container restart — research agents persist their findings to scratchpad files as they go; (9) an unquoted heredoc expands `$` and backticks — card bodies go through quoted heredocs with placeholders substituted afterwards.
- Timers: Routine `trig_01AGpv4wMw88KexCH41wPrGH`; every accelerator of this shift is spent (the last, `trig_0137pJpaAunZPZtuW2PzsLjw`, fired at 2026-10-07T13:39Z and filed #22082 and #22083). Standby relies on the Routine; no PR subscription is live.
